# Copilot Instructions for MEU Repository

## Repository Overview

This is the MEU repository. When working in this repository, follow these guidelines to ensure consistency and quality.

## General Guidelines

### Code Style
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
- Follow the established patterns and conventions in the codebase
- Use meaningful variable and function names that clearly describe their purpose

### Development Practices
- Make minimal, focused changes that address specific issues
- Test changes thoroughly before committing
- Write clear, descriptive commit messages
- Keep the codebase organized and maintainable

### Documentation
- Document new features and functionality
- Update existing documentation when making changes
- Include inline comments for complex logic
- Maintain clear and concise README files

### Security
- Never commit sensitive information (API keys, passwords, tokens)
- Follow security best practices
- Validate and sanitize all user inputs
- Keep dependencies up to date

## Testing
- Write tests for new functionality
- Ensure existing tests pass before committing
- Maintain good test coverage
- Test edge cases and error conditions

## Version Control
- Use descriptive branch names
- Keep commits atomic and focused
- Write clear commit messages following conventional commit format
- Review changes before pushing

## Collaboration
- Be respectful and professional in all communications
- Provide constructive feedback in code reviews
- Ask questions when requirements are unclear
- Share knowledge and help team members

## Best Practices
- Follow DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) principles
- Keep functions and methods small and focused
- Use appropriate error handling
- Optimize for readability first, then performance
- Consider maintainability and scalability
